description: This file defines the Smarty_Variable class, which models a template variable in the Smarty templating engine. It includes properties for variable value and cache control, as well as constructor and string conversion methods.

classes.name: Smarty_Variable
classes.description: Represents a template variable in the Smarty PHP templating engine, managing value storage, cache behavior, and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Smarty_Variable object with optional value and cache control.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the variable's value.
